description: Search CdpHub's directory of CDP integrations by keyword, CDP, category, direction or how the integration runs. Returns the exact totals, the first results and the link to the same search on cdphub.com. Use get_tool for one named tool and check_stack for several.

directions.description: Which way data moves, from the CDP's side: "out" sends data to the tool, "into" reads from it, "both", or "unknown" when the listing doesn't say.

group.description: Group the results by tool or by listing. Leave it out to let the directory decide.

query.description: Words to search for in tool, listing and CDP names, categories and descriptions, for example "reverse etl".

runs.description: How the integration runs: server-side, client-side, through a warehouse, or "none" when the listing doesn't say.

sort.description: The result order. Leave it out to let the directory decide.

name: search_directory
title: Search the directory
